chapter: Danny's rise through New York bands to Cab Calloway
title: Wilbur De Paris takes the tips and bans drinking
summary: In Wilbur De Paris's band Wilbur kept the tips for promotion and told players off for drinking.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: have no money. He was the first musician that I know who said the tips belonged to him. See, the people would come to the bandstand and say, "Ten dollars, play a 'Saints' or play so-and-so." And he'd put his (?) and say, "We've got some tips." So I'd say, "Well, where is the tips money, man?" He said, "Well, I need this money for our... If we're going to get anywhere, we need this money for promotion. I've got to write people. I've got to write letters. I need this money." I said, "You know, man, no musician I've worked with them have ever taken tips." So Simeon and them allowed it... Then he didn't want you to drink. But when you play Jazz, you're with Jazz people, and they're drinking, and they're offering you a drink. See? So you have a drink. So I take a drink. So he says, "All this drinkin'; this band will never go anywhere with drunkards." So he's hitting at me, you know.
